item.title: Wärtsilä to divest Gas Solutions business to Mutares SE & Co. KGaA
item.description: Wärtsilä has agreed to divest its Gas Solutions business to the German private equity investor, Mutares SE & Co. KGaA.

item.title: MENA: A region poised to deliver
item.description: In our October 2025 issue of LNG Industry, Chris Strong, Partner, Steven Wilson, Counsel, and Garrett Finch, Associate, Vinson & Elkins, explore the changing role the Middle East and North Africa region will play in the global LNG Industry.

item.title: TT-Line signs contract for new Green Ship 2.0
item.description: TT-Line has signed the contract for the construction of a new Green RoPax vessel.

item.title: Transforming LNG custody transfer
item.description: In our December 2025 issue of LNG Industry, Jirko Lehmann, Product Manager at Endress+Hauser SICK, discusses recent advancements in ultrasonic flowmeter technology, which form a precise, reliable, and low maintenance solution for LNG measurement.

item.title: BP p.l.c. announces leadership transition
item.description: bp has appointed Meg O’Neill as bp’s next CEO, effective 1 April 2026.

item.title: Fluor to divest Zhuhai Fabrication Yard
item.description: Fluor Corp. has reached an agreement to divest its portion of its Zhuhai fabrication yard in China’s Guangdong province to Offshore Oil Engineering Co., Ltd.

item.title: Caturus authorises full purchase orders for Commonwealth LNG
item.description: Caturus has authorised full purchase orders for major equipment in anticipation of final investment decision for the Commonwealth LNG export facility in Louisiana, the US.

item.title: Sawgrass LNG & Power celebrates eight years of LNG supply to Bahamas
item.description: Sawgrass LNG & Power has celebrated eight years of LNG exports to The Bahamas, marking a significant milestone in US-Bahamian energy co-operation.

item.title: Harnessing digital innovations to optimise LNG transportation efficiency
item.description: In our November 2025 issue of LNG Industry, Nick Fryer, Vice President of Marketing, Sheer Logistics, addresses the challenges facing modern LNG transportation and explores the digital innovations that can be implemented to combat them.

item.title: ViGo Bioenergy acquires Drive Systems
item.description: ViGo Bioenergy has announced the acquisition of Drive Systems, Belgium’s leading independent LNG station network.
